scene: public EPIC-KITCHENS P03_28 egocentric bottle workspace

actions.label: pour-bottle
actions.instruction: Starting with the bottle already held in the right robot hand, lift it, tilt it to pour into the nearby basin, return it upright, place it on the counter, and retract.

phases.name: stabilize
phases.description: preserve the existing right-hand grasp on the blue bottle while the left hand stays clear

phases.name: lift
phases.description: lift the held bottle toward the basin while keeping it upright

phases.name: pour
phases.description: tilt the blue bottle about 70 degrees above the basin and hold a causal pouring pose

phases.name: upright
phases.description: rotate the bottle upright without releasing it

phases.name: place
phases.description: lower the bottle onto the counter and open the right fingers only after support

phases.name: retract
phases.description: retract both robot hands while the bottle remains stationary on the counter

actions.label: shake-bottle
actions.instruction: Starting with the bottle already held in the right robot hand, secure it with both hands, shake it side to side several times, stop upright, place it on the counter, and retract.

phases.name: stabilize
phases.description: preserve the existing right-hand grasp on the blue bottle

phases.name: secure
phases.description: bring the left hand onto the bottle and establish a two-hand hold

phases.name: shake
phases.description: shake the upright bottle through four visible left-right cycles with both hands

phases.name: settle
phases.description: stop the bottle upright and pause before lowering

phases.name: place
phases.description: place the bottle on the counter and release only after it is supported

phases.name: retract
phases.description: retract both robot hands without moving the bottle

actions.label: handover-bottle
actions.instruction: Starting with the bottle already held in the right robot hand, bring it to the center, transfer it into the left robot hand, separate the hands, and hold the bottle only in the left hand.

phases.name: present
phases.description: preserve the existing right-hand grasp and bring the upright blue bottle to the center while the left hand opens

phases.name: dual-contact
phases.description: close the left fingers around the bottle while the right hand keeps contact

phases.name: transfer
phases.description: release the right fingers only after the left-hand grasp is established

phases.name: separate
phases.description: move the empty right hand away while the left hand holds the bottle

phases.name: display
phases.description: hold the bottle visibly in only the left hand without placing or pouring it
